headerDisplay:
**Somfy TaHoma only:** version 3 supports the local API and the Somfy cloud. Cozytouch, Hi Kumo, Flexom and Energeasy: use version 2.x.

**Several gateways or accounts:** one configuration per TaHoma gateway or cloud account. With **+** (at the bottom) you add another one – only needed for a second gateway or an additional Somfy account. Never add the same gateway twice. Give each configuration its own name and run each as a separate **child bridge** (Homebridge settings → Bridges): Homebridge does not load the same platform twice in one bridge.

name.title: Name
name.description: Shown in the Homebridge log. Must be unique if you use several configurations.

user.title: User / gateway
user.description: Local API: gateway PIN (XXXX-XXXX-XXXX) or IP address of the gateway. Cloud: e-mail address of your account.

password.title: Password / token
password.description: Local API: token generated in the TaHoma app (Developer Mode). Cloud: password of your account.

exposeScenarios.title: Scenarios as switches (cloud only)
exposeScenarios.description: Show the scenarios of the TaHoma app as switches in Apple Home; switching one on starts the scenario. Only with a cloud service – the local API does not offer scenarios.

items.title: Name or type
items.description: Device or scenario name as shown in the Homebridge log at startup (e.g. "Garage" from the line "Configure device Garage") or in the TaHoma app – or a type from the line below it (e.g. "PositionableHorizontalAwning", "Light") or a radio protocol ("io", "rts"). One name per entry – use the button below for each further one.

pollingPeriod.title: Update interval (s)
pollingPeriod.description: How often the plugin asks the gateway for changes made elsewhere (TaHoma app, remote, other systems). Default: 5 with the local API, 60 with the cloud (cloud: at least 10, at most 60).

refreshPeriod.title: Full refresh interval (min)
refreshPeriod.description: How often all device states are read again completely, in case a change was missed. Local API: re-reads the states the gateway knows, cheap and without radio traffic (default 5). Cloud: asks the gateway to query the devices – the Somfy cloud allows this only once a day (default 1440). 0 = off. Devices without feedback (RTS) cannot report their state either way.

tlsInsecure.title: Skip certificate check (local API)
tlsInsecure.description: Only if the connection to the gateway fails with a certificate error. By default the gateway certificate is verified against the Overkiz root CA.

debug.title: Debug log
debug.description: More detailed log for all devices (commands, states, requests to the gateway) – for troubleshooting only. For a single device use "Debug log" under *Device specific config*.

key.title: Device name or type
key.description: Device name from the log ("Configure device …") or the TaHoma app, or a device type such as "RollerShutter".

reverse.title: Reverse direction
reverse.description: Swap open and close, e.g. after a wrong installation.

defaultPosition.title: Position after a command
defaultPosition.description: Only for devices without position feedback (RTS, up/down only): position shown in Apple Home after a command, e.g. 50.

movementDuration.title: Movement duration (s)
movementDuration.description: Only for devices without position feedback (RTS): time for a full movement from open to closed. Enables intermediate positions – the plugin stops the device after the calculated time. 0 = off.

offsetMovementDuration.title: Start delay (s)
offsetMovementDuration.description: Used with the movement duration: extra time until the device actually starts moving.

lowSpeed.title: Low speed
lowSpeed.description: Only for roller shutters with low speed (widget PositionableRollerShutterWithLowSpeedManagement): always move with the silent low speed. A time slot such as "22:00-07:00" can be set in the JSON config.

blindMode.title: Blind mode
blindMode.description: Only for venetian / exterior blinds: the main slider controls the slats – 100 % fully open, 0 % fully closed, 1–99 % closed with tilted slats.

blindsOnRollerShutter.title: Blinds on roller shutter motor
blindsOnRollerShutter.description: Only for blinds driven by a roller shutter motor: at intermediate positions the blind moves a little further back to open the slats.

cyclic.title: Cyclic door
cyclic.description: Only for garage doors and gates without state feedback that close by themselves: show "closed" again after the cycle duration.

cycleDuration.title: Cycle duration (s)
cycleDuration.description: Used with "Cyclic door": time until the door is shown as closed again. Default 5.

pedestrianDuration.title: Pedestrian opening (s)
pedestrianDuration.description: Only for gates without a pedestrian command (RTS): open for this time, then stop. Shown as an extra lock in Apple Home.

stayZones.title: Zones for "Home"
stayZones.description: Only for alarm systems: zones armed in Apple Home's "Home" mode, e.g. "A" or "A,C". Default A.

nightZones.title: Zones for "Night"
nightZones.description: Only for alarm systems: zones armed in Apple Home's "Night" mode. Default B.

derogationDuration.title: Temporary order duration (h)
derogationDuration.description: Only for Atlantic / Thermor heating zones: duration of temporary temperature changes. Default 1.

comfort.title: Comfort temperature (°C)
comfort.description: Only for electrical heaters with pilot wire: temperature that stands for the comfort mode. Default 19.

eco.title: Eco temperature (°C)
eco.description: Only for electrical heaters with pilot wire: temperature that stands for the eco mode. Default 17.

debug.title: Debug log
debug.description: For all devices: log at startup which commands and states the gateway offers for this device, and more details about its commands (for troubleshooting).

layout.title: Devices and scenarios
layout.description: Which devices and scenarios appear in Apple Home. By default all supported devices are shown. A hidden device is removed from Apple Home, including its room and automations.

items.title: Hidden devices and scenarios
items.description: One entry per device, scenario or type to hide – add each with the button below (e.g. one entry "io", another one "rts"). Several names separated by commas in one entry work as well.
items.buttonText: Add device or scenario to hide

layout.title: Device specific config
layout.description: Optional settings for single devices or device types. Most devices need none. Add an entry, enter the device name (as shown in the Homebridge log at startup: "Configure device …" followed by the name) or a device type, and set only the options of the section that matches the device – the other sections have no effect on it.

layout.title: Advanced settings
layout.description: Usually not needed – the defaults suit most installations.
